description: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform for collecting and analyzing metrics, traces, and logs. It is available as both a self-hosted deployment and a managed SigNoz Cloud service.
summary: SigNoz exposes a documented HTTP API for its observability platform and a hosted MCP server for SigNoz Cloud; both require authentication, using service-account API keys for the HTTP API and OAuth for the MCP server.
